text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers checking in at Dock Doors 14–18 at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the 04:00 shift got through the gate without any manual steps. The same note also has an item to save the Eau Claire kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea opened it about the gatehouse barcode scanners not reading trailer tags at Door 14 during the third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for testing the scanner firmware. The note has no date, so I can't tell where this one stands now.

Moss's other notes mention Quarrendon Freight Lines but give no ticket numbers. Those are the 9/14/2025 pipeline digest and the 3/23/2026 renewal check-in. I also checked Moss's Central team notes. Their tickets (#4409, #4412 and FR-882) belong to Marrow accounts, so I left them out. Watch out for "Quarendon Freightways" with one "r": it's a different company and not a customer.

I only searched what you can see yourself: the public notes and your channels. Moss hasn't posted in any of those channels.
